title: TCKT_VNEXT SA-r-1c: GET-only re-read of run 4's analysis stage, and open the report from the ticket if one exists
author: 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~TV2

legs.proof_required: upsert the same synthetic filer row with allowedFirmIds LIST [49financial] and read it back PRESENT
ONE RS256 token, CURRENT slot, v2.2 claims, exp = iat + 15 min (run + 5); memory only; key read reported after via MSTR~DELL2

GET the analysis request and record the CONTRACT field stage (state only as an annotation), polling at most 10 times 30s apart while stage is RECEIVED/PARSED/READY/SUBMITTING; then GET the ticket and, if stage is GENERATED or RELEASED, open the report its report_ref names through the served route, recording status, content-type, byte length and sha256 prefix only. Any stage is a RESULT, not a STOP. No POST, no upload, no ticket write, no census

WAIT until the token exp has passed, THEN delete the row and read it back ABSENT with ConsistentRead. The proof prints the exp, the delete time and the absent read -- this ordering is the fix for row TCKT_VNEXT-D2-S20, where deleting the row first REMOVED the narrowing and left the token wider until exp

append run_5 to org/tier2_senior/0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~TV2/deliverables/sa_r1/sa_r1b_trace.json ONLY (AMENDMENT 1: the issuer copies the identical bytes into R1_RUN), carrying NO client data -- statuses, stage, artifact ids, byte lengths and sha256 prefixes only
